name: Tenshi no Roman Holiday
original_name: 天使のロマンホリデー
source:
You are a new angel. Follow Senpai's instructions and talk to the sinners who have fallen into hell. But there are some scum that are too clueless. In that case, it might be a good idea to be a little mean.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7006]NovelGame[/url]]
